name: Solenne Atelier Voidmarrow Couture Shroud
description:
A one-of-a-kind commission by Solenne Atelier's lead designer Mira Voss-Okafor, the Voidmarrow Shroud is constructed from hand-cultivated bioluminescent spider-silk analog grown in a controlled geneware substrate — each panel takes eleven weeks to produce. The base fabric is near-weightless, hanging in liquid folds of deep void-black that emit a cold blue-white inner light visible only in darkness. Embedded along the hem and cuffs are fragments of recovered deep-lake iron ore, polished and set as structural weights that give the garment its signature gravity-defying float-and-drop silhouette.

The rear panel accommodates decorative non-functional wings as a gene-compatible drape feature. No two Voidmarrow Shrouds are identical. This piece was commissioned for a Spire gala and has since been photographed in eleven corponation media feeds.
functionality: Bioluminescent panels activate in low-light environments. Iron ore hem weights create controlled drape physics that photograph distinctively. Gene-compatible rear panel drapes over decorative wing modifications without structural interference. BCI-responsive inner lining adjusts thermal output for climate comfort.
what_it_says: This person does not buy fashion — they commission it, and the world notices.
story_hooks: The Voidmarrow Shroud is reported stolen from a Spire penthouse — the owner refuses to involve CorpSec and is quietly hiring a private retrieval team.
A high-resolution image of the shroud contains a steganographic data payload embedded in the bioluminescent pattern — someone used the media coverage as a dead-drop.
Mira Voss-Okafor is approached to create a second Voidmarrow piece for a client she cannot identify — the commission offer is triple the original price.
related_entities: Tessera Corponation Neuroshock Suppression Patch — 'The Pall'

physical_description.visual_profile: A floor-length ethereal wrap that defies gravity, appearing to float and cascade simultaneously. The silhouette is otherworldly—deep void-black fabric with an inner cold blue-white luminescence that pulses faintly in low light. Dramatic rear panel drapes with gene-compatible wing-shaped folds that move independently of body motion. The overall impression is of liquid darkness given form.
physical_description.fit: Loose, flowing, non-restrictive wrap construction. Designed to move fluidly around the body rather than conform to it. The fabric seems to resist gravity, creating unexpected volume and suspension. Cuffs and hem sit with deliberate weight despite the weightless material.
physical_description.primary_material: Hand-cultivated bioluminescent spider-silk analog grown in controlled geneware substrate. Near-weightless synthetic protein fiber with intrinsic light-emission properties.
physical_description.texture: Impossibly smooth and liquid to touch, with a slight static quality. The surface appears to shift between matte and subtle sheen depending on light source. Embedded polished deep-lake iron ore fragments create tactile anchor points along hem and cuffs—cool, dense, grounding.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep void-black base with internal cold blue-white bioluminescence. The glow intensifies in darkness and becomes nearly invisible in bright daylight. No accent colors—the luminescence IS the secondary color system.
physical_description.closures: None visible. The shroud appears to drape and self-organize through the weight distribution of embedded iron ore fragments and the fabric's natural structure.
distinctive_features: Hand-cultivated bioluminescent fiber—eleven weeks per panel to produce
Polished deep-lake iron ore fragments set as structural weights along hem and cuffs
Rear panel accommodates decorative gene-compatible wing drape feature
Each piece unique—no two shrouds identical
Gravity-defying float-and-drop silhouette caused by material properties and weight distribution
Visible only in darkness due to bioluminescence activation
One-of-a-kind commissioned piece with documented media presence across eleven corpo feeds
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 ultra-luxury. This is a statement piece that only the wealthiest Spire residents could commission or afford.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearing this signals extreme wealth, access to cutting-edge geneware fabrication, and membership in the highest echelons of corpo society. It's a piece for galas, public appearances, and documented moments. Suggests the wearer is either a high-ranking executive, media personality, or generational wealth holder.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine. Custom pieces of this caliber are preserved carefully. The bioluminescence remains stable with proper care. Each wearing is likely a documented event.

image_prompt: A Tier-1 fashion photograph of the Solenne Atelier Voidmarrow Shroud on an elegant neo-noir model in a darkened Spire penthouse setting. The shroud drapes in liquid black folds with cold blue-white bioluminescence emanating from within, creating an ethereal glow against the darkness. The rear panel spreads into dramatic wing-like folds that seem to float rather than hang. Polished iron ore fragments along the hem and cuffs catch minimal ambient light. The model stands in profile, face serene, augmented features subtly visible.
